title: High molecular weight gDNA extraction for nanopore sequencing
author: Miriam Schalamun
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.khkct4w
materials: Before ginding make sure tissue is completely frozen in liquid nitrogen and do the grinding steps as quickly as possible to avoid freeze thawing. The grinding reck can also be frozen to ensure that. Grind tissue using an automated grinder (Qiagen TissueLyzer II) for 40 seconds (actual grinding time may differ from tissue to tissue) 00:00:40, Ginding

Transfer the DNA solutions into one tube and add TE-Buffer to make up a total volume of 500 µL If the extraction is done with multiple tubes at a time (which usually is the case), then after the elution step all the eluted DNA can just be pipettet into one tube.

steps.title: Prepare fresh lysis buffer (10 mL)
steps.instruction: Combine in a clean container to a final volume of 10 mL: 1 mL 1 % PVP 40 (10 % stock), 1 mL 1 % PVP 10 (10 % stock), 1 mL 500 mM NaCl (5 M stock), 1 mL 100 mM Tris pH 8 (1 M stock), 1 mL 50 mM EDTA (0.5 M stock), 625 µL 1.25 % SDS (20 % stock), 0.1 g sodium metabisulfite (190.1 g mol⁻¹), 50 µL 5 mM DTT (1 M stock), and 4.3 mL Milli‑Q water. Heat the buffer to 64 °C for 30 min (DNase heat‑inactivation), cool to room temperature and add RNase A at 1 µL per mL (10 µL total for 10 mL).

steps.title: Prepare tissue tubes and freeze
steps.instruction: Label 2 mL Eppendorf tubes, place 1–2 metal beads (5 mm) and 100 mg fresh tissue (or frozen tissue kept in liquid nitrogen) into each tube, then snap‑freeze by immersing the tubes in liquid nitrogen.

steps.title: Add preheated buffer and homogenize
steps.instruction: Add 700 µL of the pre‑heated lysis buffer to each tube, invert repeatedly until no frozen clumps remain (may take a few minutes).

steps.title: Incubate lysate at 37 °C
steps.instruction: Place tubes in a thermomixer set to 37 °C, shaking at 400 rpm (slow) for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Cool lysate on ice
steps.instruction: Remove tubes from the thermomixer and incubate on ice for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Centrifuge lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge tubes at 8000 g for 12 minutes at 4 °C.

steps.title: Transfer supernatant
steps.instruction: Carefully transfer ~600 µL of the clear supernatant to a new 1.5 mL tube without disturbing the pellet.

steps.title: Bind DNA with magnetic beads
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume (~600 µL) of pre‑prepared magnetic beads solution (room temperature, vortex beads alone for ~30 seconds; do NOT vortex the sample). Invert gently to mix.

steps.title: Incubate bead mixture on rotor
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube on a rotor for 10 minutes at room temperature; pre‑heat TE buffer to 50 °C for later use.

steps.title: Quick spin and magnetize
steps.instruction: Spin the tube for 1 second, then place it in a magnetic rack for 5 minutes until beads collect on the tube wall and the solution becomes clear.

steps.title: First ethanol wash
steps.instruction: While the tube remains on the magnetic rack, add 1 mL fresh 70 % ethanol, wait 30 seconds, then remove the supernatant without disturbing the beads.

steps.title: Second ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Repeat the addition of 1 mL 70 % ethanol, wait 30 seconds, and remove the supernatant as before.

steps.title: Final spin and air‑dry beads
steps.instruction: Spin the tube for 1 second, keep it on the magnetic rack to remove residual ethanol, then air‑dry the beads for exactly 30 seconds (no longer).

steps.title: Elute DNA with TE buffer
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL TE buffer pre‑heated to 50 °C (volume may be adjusted between 20–100 µL as needed) and flick the tube to resuspend the beads.

steps.title: Collect eluate
steps.instruction: Spin for 1 second, place tube on magnetic rack, incubate 5–10 minutes until solution is clear, then transfer the supernatant (eluted DNA) to a fresh tube.

steps.title: Initial DNA quantification
steps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration with a Qubit fluorometer and absorbance with a NanoDrop. Desired values: Qubit/NanoDrop 0.5–1.0 µg/µL, 260/280 = 1.8–2.0, 260/230 = 2.0–2.2.

steps.title: Proteinase K cleanup – add enzyme
steps.instruction: Add 10 µL Proteinase K per tube and incubate 20–30 minutes at 37 °C in the thermomixer.

steps.title: Add potassium acetate and ice
steps.instruction: Add 210 µL (~0.3 vol) of 5 M potassium acetate, invert the tube 20 times, then keep the tube on ice (~4 °C).

steps.title: Incubate beads at room temperature
steps.instruction: Incubate the resuspended beads for 10 minutes at room temperature to allow DNA to re‑elute.

steps.title: Chloroform‑isoamyl alcohol extraction
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL (1 vol) chloroform:isoamyl alcohol (24:1), invert the tube about 100 times (≥2 minutes).

steps.title: Phase separation centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 8000 g, 4 °C for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Collect aqueous phase
steps.instruction: Transfer the upper (aqueous) phase to a new tube, discard the lower organic phase; repeat steps 20–21 if any interphase material is transferred.

steps.title: Add sodium acetate
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL (0.1 vol) 3 M sodium acetate, invert the tube 10–20 times.

steps.title: Ethanol precipitation of DNA
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL (1 vol) 100 % ethanol, invert gently a few times, then incubate at 4 °C for 5–10 minutes until DNA precipitates (visible as a thickening or air‑bubble‑bound pellet).

steps.title: Centrifuge precipitate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 4 °C, 5000 g for 2 minutes. If no pellet is visible, centrifuge again at 10000 g for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Remove supernatant carefully
steps.instruction: Pipette the supernatant off from the side opposite the pellet; if the pellet is translucent, transfer the supernatant to a new tube for a repeat centrifugation.

steps.title: First 70 % ethanol wash of pellet
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL 70 % ethanol to the pellet to wash away salts, then centrifuge at 4 °C, 8000 g for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Second 70 % ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Remove supernatant, repeat the addition of 1 mL 70 % ethanol, centrifuge as above, and ensure all ethanol is removed.

steps.title: Air‑dry DNA pellet
steps.instruction: Air‑dry the pellet for 2–5 minutes (drying time is not critical).

steps.title: Final DNA elution
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL pre‑heated (50 °C) 10 mM Tris pH 8 or TE buffer, incubate until the pellet fully dissolves (overnight at room temperature if pellet is large).

steps.title: Final DNA quantification
steps.instruction: Measure DNA concentration again with Qubit and NanoDrop as described in step 15.
